cohort: 205 pregnant women with a diagnosis of a psychotic disorder (n=180 exposed to antipsychotics, n=25 unexposed)
finding: Women exposed to first-generation antipsychotics (FGAs) during pregnancy were at a higher risk of developing gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) compared to those taking second-generation antipsychotics (SGAs) or no antipsychotics.
mod_finding: Women exposed to first-generation antipsychotics during pregnancy had an increased risk of developing gestational diabetes mellitus compared to those who were not exposed.
